tasks.title: Enemies can idle on patrol around an anchor, notice the player with a short beat, and drop back to patrol only once the player is well out of range
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufs7ek60001nm2x6d0bt2et/3-plan.md §2.5. New global/enemy_ai/anchor_idle.gd (AnchorIdle, RefCounted). It holds anchor, perceive_radius, lose_radius and notice_time, and update() returns IDLE / NOTICING / COMBAT / RETURNING. The idle path does squared-distance checks only. - RETURNING → IDLE at the anchor. `bash /agent/verify.sh` passes; `scripts/check-test-leaks.sh` reports no leaks.
